==============================================================================
  APEX RADIANCE {VERSION}
  Lighting, picture and performance for The Sims 3
==============================================================================

  What is in this zip

    ApexLauncher.exe ........... Apex Launcher: installs, updates and
                                  starts the game (recommended)
    Manual install\ ............ the mod files and the RTX Remix bridge,
                                  to install them by hand


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OPTION 1  -  INSTALL WITH APEX LAUNCHER  (recommended)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    1.  Close The Sims 3 and its launcher.
    2.  Run ApexLauncher.exe.
    3.  Pick your game, then click Install.
    4.  When it asks how to use it, keep "Install (recommended)".

  That's it. The launcher finds the game (Steam or EA app), installs
  Apex Radiance and everything it needs, and checks your other mods.
  It adds itself to the Start menu, the desktop and Installed apps.

  Already using Apex Radiance Setup? Open it: it updates itself into
  Apex Launcher and keeps your games, language and settings.

  From then on, start the game from Apex Launcher to:

    -  get updates with one click, or when you press Play
    -  check that everything is in place (Health)
    -  see and switch off your mods, worlds and saves
    -  repair, remove or undo a change (a restore point is kept
       before every change)

  To remove everything: Windows Settings > Apps > Installed apps >
  Apex Launcher > Uninstall. Your saves and your own mods stay.


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OPTION 2  -  INSTALL BY HAND
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Open the "Manual install" folder and follow "How to install.txt".


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AFTER INSTALLING
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Start the game, load a world and press  Ctrl + Shift + F11  to open
  the Apex Radiance menu.

  Your settings are kept between updates, in:
    Documents\Electronic Arts\The Sims 3\Apex Radiance


  Help, bug reports and every version:
    https://github.com/loinyx/Sims3-ApexRadiance
